_about: DC: Dark Legion event + Bleed timeline, curated by hand from the official Discord archive (Supabase game_posts, game=dcdl). Every fact cites the post(s) it comes from with a short verbatim quote; scripts/check-dcdl-event-history.mjs verifies them (--write stamps each source with its postedAt). Shown at /games/dc-dark-legion/event-history and on champion pages. Fields named note are internal and never rendered; quantumsTake is Tyler's text only.
caveats: Since early 2025 the official patch notes only say the Hypertime Tracker changed "on some servers", so per-server banner and rerun dates are not listed here.
A champion's date is the official reveal post or the event they debuted in, which matches their first appearance on the oldest servers.

Server groups: the soft-launch Earths 200-205 (open before the March 14, 2025 global launch, since merged into Earth 200) and the global-launch Earths 206 and up. Their Bleed orders split after Nightwing in mid-2025.
Posts from June to November 2024 belong to the earlier version of the game, and progress from it did not carry over, so this history starts with the current version.
Soft-launch patch notes from mid-December 2024 to February 2025 are missing from the official Discord archive, so that stretch is thin.

observations.text: Both Septembers so far had a Bat-Family themed event: Echoes of the Batcave in 2025, and the same event again in 2026.
The biggest occasions (Halloween 2025, the first anniversary in March 2026, the Supergirl movie in June 2026) each introduced an event-only champion.
Two themed events have come back so far, each about a year after the first run. The 2026 runs added a base skin to the rewards.

openQuestions: The July/August 2025 newsletter's highlights say 'Long-term Bleed rerun plans revealed!', but that section is not in the archived text (post 1408293943086546974). Can Tyler paste it from Discord?
Is the July 2025 'Hypertime Tracker: Superman' the 'first cross-server rerun banner' the June newsletter promised? Likely, but no post says so.
Batman Death Metal: is he Iconic? The site lists him as Iconic; the official posts never use the word for him.

Batgirl, Red Robin, Doctor Fate, Harley Quinn and The Flash are on the site as Mythic+ versions. The archive only covers Batman/Flash/Aquaman/Harley as planned limited Mythics for new servers (2026-05-14) and the Batman/Green Lantern/Aquaman upgrade (2026-09-16). When did the others go limited, and on which servers?

First banner dates for the soft-launch roster (Superman, Sinestro, Constantine, Nightwing and others) and the June 2025 champions (Starfire, Martian Manhunter on global servers) are not in the archive.
Superman Death Metal was announced on 2026-10-12 for the upcoming Halloween event; it is not released yet, so it is left out until the patch ships.
